_note: Accuracy test set for triage: 45 realistic merchant messages (15 English, 15 Hindi, 15 Hinglish) with expected intents. Labels are ground truth; improve the lexicon, never the labels. E15, E30 and E45 (hello, नमस्ते, hii) were relabelled UNKNOWN -> SMALL_TALK when greetings became their own intent.
